Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
a) Will Aching Beauty trigger on a successful block before I play Psychomachia?
b) If yes, is it compulsory to trigger Aching Beauty before playing Psychomachia, or can I play Psychomachia to somehow prevent the Methuselah from losing pool?
c) If it does not trigger before playing Psychomachia, will it still trigger after playing Psychomachia?

Aching Beauty
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, KoT:U]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Toreador
Cost: 2 pool
Master.
Put this card on a Toreador. If this Toreador is blocked, the controller of the blocking minion burns 1 pool (before combat occurs, if any).

Psychomachia
[BL:C2, KMW:PB3]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Daimoinon/Presence
Only usable when an ally or younger vampire successfully blocks before tapping the blocker.
Cancel the current action and untap this acting vampire. The blocking minion is not tapped.
The block fails, and the action continues. The blocking minion cannot attempt to block this action again.
As  above, and the blocking minion takes 1 damage (damage not preventable).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> the1andonlime wrote:
> a) Will Aching Beauty trigger on a successful block before I play Psychomachia?
>
With the current cardtext, yes.

> the1andonlime wrote:
> b) If yes, is it compulsory to trigger Aching Beauty before playing Psychomachia, or can I play Psychomachia to somehow prevent the Methuselah from losing pool?
>
Compulsory.

> the1andonlime wrote:
> c) If it does not trigger before playing Psychomachia, will it still trigger after playing Psychomachia?
>
TBC by Floppy, but passive effects (here: Aching Beauty) kick in first.
